title: WhatsApp resilience, notifications & version label
summary: Local WhatsApp gateway reconnects more reliably, the notification panel is fully clickable, and the top-bar version chip always shows the real build tag instead of Systempatch.
highlights: WhatsApp gateway: infinite recoverable reconnect, stability probes, and a Windows stay-awake launcher for long-running local servers.
Top bar: bell, settings, and WhatsApp icons wire reliably again after shell syntax fixes.
Notifications: Mark all read always works; viewing an item dismisses and removes it from the list.
Version pill: rejects bogus ?appv=Systempatch values and never writes marketing labels into the cache-bust query.
